title: Crunchy Japanese-Style Rice Salad with Yum-Yum Sauce
ingredients: 1 quantity Yum-Yum Sauce (see Jazz It Up chapter)
method: Cook the brown rice according to the package instructions.
While the rice is cooking, prepare the vegetables and the yum-yum sauce.
When the rice is cooked, drain in a sieve, then hold under running water to cool. Allow to fully drain.
In a large bowl, mix the cooled brown rice with the sugarsnap peas, radishes, cucumber, spring onions, carrot and edamame.
Serve with the yum-yum sauce alongside in a separate bowl so people can dress their own portion.
notes: Cooked shredded chicken, prawns, tuna or finely sliced steak go really well with this salad. Try adding peppers, green beans, steamed broccoli or cooked peas and sweetcorn.
